about: Seeded defects, one per gate rule that had no test proving it can fail. test/harness/gate_evals_test.dart runs each case through the real rule and requires the named id to fire, then refuses any declared rule id that neither this corpus nor the gate's own test exercises. A gate that has never been seen failing is a gate that may never fail.
